Feedback"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Google's Elephant-Goldfish Model, adapted for DeepSeek Harness."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Meet the Elephant 🐘"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"The Elephant is your long-running design partner."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"It explores your project, reads the relevant code, asks questions, and helps you work through altern"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"atives. It keeps track of the decisions you've made and the reasons behind them. Together, you devel"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"op a design document."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"But the Elephant has a problem. **It remembers too much.**"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"After hours of discussion, it understands what you meant, even when you haven't written it down. Ask"},{"id":"p11s2","text":" the Elephant whether the design makes sense, and it might unconsciously fill in the gaps from your "},{"id":"p11s3","text":"earlier conversation."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"That's dangerous, because whoever implements the design next won't necessarily have that context."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"We need someone who doesn't remember."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Meet the Goldfish 🐟"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The Goldfish starts fresh."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"It hasn't participated in your design discussions. It doesn't know why you chose a particular archit"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"ecture or which requirements you explained but forgot to write down. It receives a self-contained re"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"view prompt, the design, and the reference material it needs. It can read and search permitted proje"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"ct files, **but it doesn't inherit the Elephant's conversation**."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Then it tries to understand what you've written."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Can it figure out how the system is supposed to work? Are the requirements unambiguous? Are failure "},{"id":"p18s2","text":"cases accounted for? Do the interfaces fit together? And, most importantly, **could someone build th"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"is correctly without having been part of the original conversation?**"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"When the Goldfish discovers a problem, the Elephant helps you address it. You revise the document, r"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"eview it again, and decide when it's ready."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"The result isn't just a specification. It's project knowledge that can survive the conversation that"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"sn't just a specification. It's project knowledge that can survive the conversation that created it."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### Why bother?"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"AI coding assistants have three recurring failure modes:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"1. **Forget.** Important decisions disappear when a conversation is compacted or restarted.
2. **Ass"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"ume.** An assistant confidently implements requirements nobody actually agreed on.
3. **Agree.** An "},{"id":"p23s3","text":"assistant reviewing its own design can quietly carry the same unwritten assumptions into the review."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"The Elephant-Goldfish Model (EGM) separates the context-rich design conversation from independent, f"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"resh-context criticism. **`dsh-egm` brings that workflow to DeepSeek Harness as a native plugin.**"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"It's useful when a feature, migration, or architectural change needs decisions before code. For a sm"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"all, well-understood bug fix, your normal coding workflow is probably enough."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"You'll need:"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"- **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x**, compatible with the package's declared range `>=0.2.1-rc.5 <0.3.0`.
- "},{"id":"p28s2","text":"**Node.js 22 or 24** (`>=22 <25`; CI tests Node 22 and 24). If you're using the DSH 0.2.2 alpha line"},{"id":"p28s3","text":", its own requirement is Node 24.9 or newer."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"*The Elephant remembers. The Goldfish starts fresh. You stay in control.*"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"The Elephant carries the project conversation forward. The Goldfish reviewers approach the written s"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"pecification without that conversational history. The human decides what to accept, reject, or inves"},{"id":"p32s3","text":"ation without that conversational history. The human decides what to accept, reject, or investigate."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"A structured `/egm-review` uses five stages: **Initial Zoom Out**, **Comprehension**, **Design Criti"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"que**, **Intermediate Zoom Out**, and **Implementation Readiness**. Different reviewers look at the "},{"id":"p33s3","text":"design from different angles, and their findings become things you can resolve, not decisions the ag"},{"id":"p33s4","text":"ents make on your behalf."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"For the fuller protocol, including the optional bootstrap step, see the detailed protocol diagram."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"### What this plugin adds"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"Google's upstream project supplies the EGM skills, reviewer personas, and design standards. This pac"},{"id":"p36s2","text":"kage supplies the DeepSeek Harness integration needed to run that workflow:"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"- **Seven native skills.** Invoke `/egm-brainstorm`, `/egm-draft`, `/egm-review`, and the other EGM "},{"id":"p37s2","text":"commands directly in Harness.
- **Fresh reviewer sessions.** The `egm_reviewer` tool starts a new ch"},{"id":"p37s3","text":"ild using the `egm-reviewer` preset and a self-contained prompt. It does not fork or inherit the Ele"},{"id":"p37s4","text":"phant's session transcript.
- **Host-enforced, read-only review.** The reviewer preset has file-read"},{"id":"p37s5","text":"ing and search tools, not file-writing, command-execution, session-reading, user-question, or delega"},{"id":"p37s6","text":"tion tools. The plugin also restricts tool visibility and guards calls against its reviewer allowlis"},{"id":"p37s7","text":"t. This is enforced through the Harness tool system, not merely by asking the model to behave.
- **T"},{"id":"p37s8","text":"raceable upstream content.** The EGM skills, personas, and standards are shipped unchanged from a pi"},{"id":"p37s9","text":"nned upstream commit. Harness-specific instructions are injected when the skills register, rather th"},{"id":"p37s10","text":"an edited into those upstream files."},{"id":"p38s1","text":"**What “read-only” does and doesn't mean:** it prevents Goldfish reviewers from using write, shell, "},{"id":"p38s2","text":"and other disallowed tools in the supported Harness configuration. It doesn't mean reviewers are una"},{"id":"p38s3","text":"ble to see project files: they can read and search material available to their permitted tools. Don'"},{"id":"p38s4","text":"t treat the reviewer preset as a confidentiality boundary, and check what project material you expos"},{"id":"p38s5","text":"the reviewer preset as a confidentiality boundary, and check what project material you expose to it."},{"id":"p39s1","text":"The package declares `>=0.2.1-rc.5 <0.3.0`; native replay evidence covers the pinned 0.2.1-rc.5 runt"},{"id":"p39s2","text":"ime on Linux, rather than every version in that range.
